name: apex-frontend
_comment: Single npm workspace root for every Apex portal SPA. This is the ONLY manifest that declares dependencies and the ONLY lockfile in the repo: each workspace package below carries just its name + build script, so a framework version cannot drift between portals (the old frontend_shared/pins.json + override-pins/dep-pins CI loops existed only to simulate this and are gone). Add a portal by adding its dir here; bump a version once, here, then `npm install` to refresh package-lock.json and rebuild every bundle.

scripts.test: npm test --prefix apex_portal && npm test -w frontend_shared && vitest run --root fleet_os && vitest run --root housing && vitest run --root route_supervisor && node worker/phone.test.mjs && node worker/qrColor.test.mjs && node worker/pullToRefresh.test.mjs && node worker/portalLibraryControls.test.mjs
